items.title: Mike Evans: Active for Monday's game
items.text:

items.title: Davante Adams: Needs surgery, eyeing post-bye return
items.text:
Adams sustained a ruptured left hamstring in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Cardinals and is slated to undergo a procedure that he hopes will allow him to return a little after the Rams' Week 11 bye, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Josh Jacobs: Comes off exempt list
